summary:
Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature in the botocore repo; nothing committed.

Changes:
- botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with eleven members (values exactly as in the spec table), each with a meaning/type comment.
- botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made the STS predicate accept an absent endpoint configuration (treated as no variant tags); added public ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of the class, reading FIPS/DualStack via the bridge's lookups and reusing the existing S3 and STS predicates.
- tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins(unittest.TestCase) with 22 tests covering every behavioral criterion; the S3 predicate test asserts exactly one call; the bundled-data and custom-data-legacy cases each have exactly one test.

Verification:
- tests/unit/test_args.py: 58 passed (all existing plus new).
- tests/unit/test_regions.py and tests/unit/test_client.py: passed.
- Full tests/unit: 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py, test_session_legacy.py. I stashed my edits and reran those three files on the original code; the same 11 fail there, so they are pre-existing environment issues (urllib3 FakeSocket lacks settimeout, and an internal-component session test).
- black/flake8 are not installed in the shared venv; line lengths were checked by hand. The only over-79 line in args.py is pre-existing.

Choices: tests use string keys rather than importing the enum; FIPS and DualStack return `value or False` without bool coercion."
